description: Defines the Wishlist class representing a user's product wishlist with serialization and utility methods.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: A model class representing a user's wishlist containing product IDs and an update timestamp.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty Wishlist instance with no product IDs and the current timestamp.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given product ID is in the wishlist.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Wishlist with optional new product IDs and update timestamp.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON map into a Wishlist object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Wishlist object into a JSON map.
